exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: Cascade PO 88120 ($212,400): bill-and-hold assessment
exchanges.body: Rachel, Brett asked to invoice Cascade PO 88120 ($212,400.00) in October as bill-and-hold. Against ASC 606-10-55-83: (a) substantive reason: met, Cascade asked in writing on 10/28 to hold until their plant is ready; (b) identified separately as Cascade's: not met, the 12 units are in general finished goods, not tagged or segregated; (c) ready for transfer: yes; (d) we can't use them or send them elsewhere: not met, 2 of the 12 were picked for Pemberton on 11/2. So it doesn't qualify for October, and the terms are FOB Destination anyway. My recommendation: no October revenue. If Cascade wants the arrangement going forward, we'd need segregated, tagged units and your written approval before month end. Your call. Elena
